notes:
ACCESS: robots.txt (https://indiacircus.com/robots.txt, reached via a 301 redirect from the www host) is effectively empty (single blank line, no Disallow rules at all) - no block on any tier. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome120) worked for every page fetched - homepage, sitemap.xml (a sitemapindex pointing to sitemap_pages.xml/sitemap_products.xml/sitemap_collections.xml), sitemap_collections.xml (231 category URLs), and every individual category page returned full server-rendered HTML (Magento-based site, .html category URLs) with an exact product-count element and product-block product cards baked into the initial response; no client-side hydration gap was found, so tiers (b)/(c) were never needed. TREE: built the union of (1) the homepage mega-menu (Home Decor, Dining, Fashion, Accessories, Furniture, Wall Decor, Collections groups), and (2) the full 231-URL ic-sitemap/sitemap_collections.xml, cross-checked against each candidate page's own 'category_seobottom' internal-link strip. Every recorded leaf's rendered h1 and was confirmed to match the requested URL/slug (e.g. /home-decor/bed-bath-linen.html was found to 301/canonicalize to /home-decor/bedding.html - same h1 'Bedding', same 50-item count - so it was treated as one node, not two). QTY: taken verbatim from the page's own rendered '

N items

' header on every category page (e.g. Cushion Covers = 278). No number was estimated, paginated-and-counted, or inferred; none of the checked pages showed 0 items. EXCLUDED and why: this is a print/design-led lifestyle brand whose catalog is overwhelmingly Kitchen & Dining (mugs/cups/saucers, drinkware, serveware/trays, bowls/platters, dinnerware, jars & containers incl. steel/bamboo jars and roti-box, lunch boxes, bamboo/copper-steel showcase, tea-coffee, tumblers/glassware, bottles, and - within the Tableware node itself - coasters, trivets, chopping boards, napkin-rings-and-stirrers, butter-dish), Decorative Home Accessories (decor-accents/figurines, candles & votives, home fragrances/incense/diffusers, decorative platters), Lighting (lamps/table-lamps), Wall Decor (wallpapers, feature/mural walls, wall-art, wall plates), Furniture (side tables & multipurpose stools, ottomans & benches, all-furniture), and Fashion/Accessories (co-ord sets, shirts, tops, kurtis, stoles, bags, wallets, neck pillows, travel tags, pocket mirrors, wrist watches, stationery, gift bags, umbrellas) - none of which are Textile or Storage per the two rule files' boundary sections, so all were skipped. /home-decor/multi-utility-storages/tissue-box-holders.html ('Tissue Holders', 27 items, product names like 'Playful Paradise Tissue Box Holder') was inspected and excluded from Storage: these are decorative fabric-covered tissue-box covers, not genuine storage/organization products, per storage.md Sec.24 Home Accessories Boundary. /accessories/home-accessories/storage-boxes.html ('Storage Boxes', 10 items) was product-SKU-compared against /home-decor/multi-utility-storages/storage-box.html and found to list the identical 10 SKUs (CON_STORAGE_000104-000113) - it is a second, non-mega-menu navigation path to the exact same listing, so only the multi-utility-storages/storage-box.html node (the one actually reachable from the visible 'storage' mega-menu link) was kept, per the duplicate-record rule. Several numeric legacy URLs in the sitemap (catalog/category/view/id/368, /470, /837-840) were spot-checked: id/368='Rakhi Gifting' (308 items, seasonal gifting collection), id/470='Sale' (0 items, promotional), id/837='Glasses & Tumblers' (0 items, Kitchen & Dining) - all promotional/seasonal/K&D and out of scope, so the remaining un-spot-checked ids (838-840) were not fabricated into rows either. One judgment call flagged MEDIUM: 'Chest of Drawers' (home-decor/multi-utility-storages/chest-of-drawers.html, 15 items, e.g. 'Blooming Meadow Chest of Drawer' and 'Blooming Meadow Small Chest of Drawer') sits on the Furniture/Storage boundary (storage.md Sec.17/Sec.21); it was classified Storage because the website's own hierarchy places it directly inside the 'Storage & Organisers' (multi-utility-storages) category rather than under /home-decor/furniture/, which storage.md Sec.21 treats as controlling. One judgment call flagged LOW: 'Cushion Fillers' (home-decor/cushion-cover/fillers.html, 12 items, e.g. 'Cushion Filler 18 x 18') are cushion inserts/stuffing rather than a fabric-surface product; textile.md Sec.4 does not explicitly list fillers, so this was kept as Textile with LOW confidence rather than silently dropped, consistent with the review-queue guidance in Sec.22/35.
